findings.statement: After a successful hotkey capture, the 3-second feedback timer resolves captureTarget after endHotkeyCapture has set it to null. The callback then selects #null-tip and dereferences textContent, producing an uncaught TypeError on every completed recording. Capture and persistence currently pass, but the settings renderer emits an asynchronous runtime error during normal recorder use.
root_cause_assumptions: ASM-001: The timeout callback executes after the synchronous endHotkeyCapture cleanup; this follows directly from setTimeout's delay and the immediate captureTarget assignment.

next_cycle_brief.objective: Repair successful hotkey capture feedback cleanup and revalidate the P1 settings boundary.
allowed_changes: Capture the target element or target id before ending capture so the delayed cleanup addresses the original tip safely.
checks: Exercise the successful capture feedback timeout or add deterministic coverage for it.
prohibited: Do not change Plan/Spec thresholds, expand into P2+, alter credentials or provider behavior, or remove this audit.
